events.title: 固定網址開張慶典
events.text: 遊戲搬去固定網址，存檔唔會再因更新而冇。慶祝一星期：所有區域獎勵 +25%！
events.textEn: The game has a permanent address now, so updates won't wipe saves. One week of +25% rewards everywhere!
